subject: Whistic onboarding for Pegasus (GovCloud SOC 2 artifacts) - next steps
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice@pegasus.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Sep 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic onboarding request — GovCloud + SOC 2 artifacts

Hi David,

Thanks for the pointer this morning. We are preparing to onboard Pegasus into Whistic to share SOC 2 artifacts and a small CAIQ subset for our procurement team. A few constraints on our side: Pegasus operates a GovCloud tenant for regulated workloads, and their compliance team requires that evidence referencing customer data be stored only in GovCloud buckets or accessed via presigned URLs with limited TTL.

Can you confirm Redwood's ability to: 
- Add Pegasus to a Whistic profile scoped to GovCloud artifacts only
- Provide S3 presigned uploads for evidence (we need TTL <= 24 hours)
- Share SOC 2 in a way that limits cross-region access

I've attached a one-pager of our initial requirements and a list of controls we expect to validate. If possible, please include a matrix of the documents you can provide (system description, SOC 2 reports, KMS rotation policy, access logs).

Best,
Alice Monroe
Security Lead | Pegasus AI
attachments: pegasus_initial_requirements.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Sep 2028 15:27:00 -0400

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear requirements. We're ready to proceed. Quick summary of what Redwood can provide and the questions we have so we can map the exact workstream: 

What we can provide today:
- Whistic profile scoped to GovCloud artifacts only and invited users limited to your security contacts
- SOC 2 Type II report PDFs and scope matrix (I attached a draft scope matrix)
- Presigned S3 upload flow for evidence with TTL configuration; default TTL is 24 hours but we can tighten to 4 hours if you need
- Audit logs and access logs for evidence uploads (we can provide S3 access logs and CloudTrail records)

Questions / clarifications:
1) Do you need Redwood to host SOC 2 documents inside a GovCloud account we operate, or is the presigned upload + Whistic hosting sufficient for Pegasus procurement?
2) For KMS: do you require that keys remain in Pegasus-managed KMS or is Redwood-managed GovCloud KMS acceptable?
3) Any required naming or evidence manifest format (some customers want CAIQ answers as a CSV)

Action items I propose:
- I will invite the Pegasus security group to our Whistic profile today (whistic invite link sent).
- Mina (cc'd) will confirm KMS and log export capability tomorrow with technical detail on rotation and retention.
- I'll attach the SOC 2 scope matrix and a proposed upload checklist.

Attachments: soc2_scope_matrix.xlsx

Thanks — I can hop on a 30-min sync tomorrow if you prefer to walk through the flow.

—David
David Kim
Director, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding request — GovCloud + SOC 2 artifacts

Hi all — technical follow-up from my side. I validated the presign/upload and KMS choices: 

- Presigned uploads: Supported. We can generate server-side presigned POSTs scoped to a single object prefix and TTL configurable per request. For evidence ingestion we recommend TTL = 2 hours; 24 hours is acceptable but increases window for accidental exposure.
- KMS: For GovCloud assets we use an AWS GovCloud KMS key in account rw-inference-gov. We can either: 
  a) Upload artifacts to an rw-inference-gov S3 bucket encrypted with our GovCloud KMS key (Redwood-managed) OR
  b) Accept presigned uploads that are then claimed and transferred into a Pegasus-owned GovCloud bucket (Pegasus-managed) — this requires cross-account presign choreography and an IAM role in Pegasus account.
- Logs & retention: CloudTrail and S3 access logs are available for 13 months by default; we can produce filtered CSV extracts for the time ranges you need.

A few asks from our compliance side to make this smooth:
- Please confirm the minimal set of artifacts you require for initial procurement (we can stage the rest).
- If Pegasus requires Pegasus-managed KMS, can Pegasus provide a role ARN for cross-account PutObject?

I've attached our KMS rotation policy snippet for your reviewers. Happy to set a technical working session to wire the presign flow and IAM role exchange.

Attachment: kms_rotation_policy.docx

—Mina
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
